justification: Title & Ownership card fix extended with the legal title identifiers: the cadastre query already fetched lotnumber but detect_strata dropped it; sectionnumber added to outFields (live-verified against the SIX cadastre layer). Lot/section now flow detect_strata -> StrataInfo -> card. Freehold lots render one sentence with the full legal reference (Lot 1, DP963483); strata lots gain a Lot-in-the-scheme row. Display + passthrough only; no engine logic changed.

pre_impl.existing_data: Renders the existing strata DataField already streamed to the page; no new data touched.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A contradictory record (is_strata false but strata_type set) renders the STRATA detail view so information is never hidden.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Pure render change applied at view time; nothing stored.

functions.name: StrataDisplay
functions.input: the strata DataField value dict already held by the page
functions.output: one prose sentence for freehold lots or labelled rows for strata lots
functions.if_none: null plan label simply omits the plan sentence; unknown scheme type falls back to the humanised enum value

functions.name: get_cadastral_info
functions.input: lat/lng point queried against the NSW SIX cadastre lot layer
functions.output: cadastre dict now including lot_number and section_number identifiers
functions.if_none: missing attributes pass through as None and the UI simply omits them from the legal reference

break_it.scenario: Contradictory upstream record says is_strata false while strata_type says apartment, and the freehold sentence hides the strata signal
break_it.what_happens: A buyer could read a strata-flagged unit as clean freehold title in the ownership card
break_it.how: StrataDisplay treats EITHER signal as strata (is_strata true OR a non-not_strata type) so the detail view wins on contradiction
break_it.repro: render brief with strata value {is_strata: false, strata_type: 'apartment'} and confirm the strata rows show

break_it.scenario: Cadastre returns lotnumber for the neighbouring buffer lot and the card shows the wrong legal reference
break_it.what_happens: A conveyancer could quote the neighbour's Lot/Plan on a contract search
break_it.how: identifiers ride the SAME cadastre feature detect_strata already selected (containment-first logic unchanged); no new query, no new matching
break_it.repro: existing detect_strata containment tests; identifiers are read from the identical feature dict
